title: Ben Dünya: Anlatacaklarım Var
author: Esat Zorkirişçi
description: This book teaches children the scientific background of natural disasters such as earthquakes. It helps them understand the marvelous cycle of nature, why earthquakes happen, and how they can stay safe during them. By helping young readers know our planet better, the story builds awareness through a knowledge-based approach that reduces fear and worry.
english_title: My Name is Earth and I Have Things To Share
